structural_constraints: S1 [锁定最相近工作 Closest Prior Work]：Among prior studies, [Closest Method A] and [Closest Method B] are most closely related to our approach.
S2 [剖析其局限性 Structural Difference 1]：While [Method A] also employs [Shared Concept], it relies on [Limitation 1], restricting its applicability to [Narrow Setting].
S3 [剖析本文本质突破 Core Departure]：In contrast, our framework introduces [Core Innovation], which fundamentally eliminates [Bottleneck] by [Mechanism].
S4 [实证或理论优势锁定 Empirical/Theoretical Edge]：Consequently, our approach achieves [Capability] without requiring [Expensive Requirement of Prior Work].
target_defects_to_fix: 机械连接词膏药 + 旧新信息流断裂与逻辑跳跃（Mechanical Connectors & Logical Leap）
消除头重脚轻（主语 ≤ 6-8 词，遵循尾重原则 L011）
消除口语词与 AI 套话（delve into / pivotal role / testament to）
补全定量指标-基线-条件三元组或具象行业微案例

genre_target: CET-6 / IELTS Task 2 原因分析段，或学术评论文章
domain_context: 雅思小作文动态/静态图表与实证数据综述
communicative_intent_zh: 我这一段想在问题分析类作文（Why is this happening?）中，剖析某个社会/科研痛点背后的深层原因（既指出直接表层诱因，又挖出底层的考核激励或结构性根源）。
prompt_zh: 【多段贯通写作实战 2：整篇小作文 / 演讲 / Rebuttal 闭环构建】结合今日所学蓝图 `BP35` 与全文样板 `FT10` 的后半部分（`BP21 -> BP22 -> BP23`），完成一篇包含“破题/总起 → 核心机制/正方论证 → 让步反驳/消融归因 → 边界收束”的完整短文，并用 `L030` 七维自检表逐项核验。
source_material_or_draft: Since I was a child, I have been fascinated by artificial intelligence and robots. In my master's degree, I did some research on time series forecasting and published a paper. In the future, I want to study embodied AI because it is a very hot topic and can help humans a lot.
structural_constraints: S1 [原因总起句 Dual-Cause Thesis]：The widespread emergence of [Problem X] stems from both immediate technological pressures and deeper institutional incentives.
S2 [第一层：直接操作/技术诱因 Immediate Driver]：At the operational level, [Factor A] lowers the cost of [Behavior], tempting individuals/organizations to [Short-term Action].

S3 [第二层：深层制度/激励根源 Structural Root Cause]：More fundamentally, existing evaluation systems reward [Superficial Metric] rather than [Long-term Quality], creating powerful pressure to prioritize speed over rigor.
S4 [双因叠加后果 Compounding Effect]：When effortless generation meets quantity-driven evaluation, [Problem X] becomes systemic rather than isolated.
target_defects_to_fix: 口语化严重 + 缺失比较基准与维度（Colloquialism & Imprecision）
消除头重脚轻（主语 ≤ 6-8 词，遵循尾重原则 L011）
消除口语词与 AI 套话（delve into / pivotal role / testament to）
补全定量指标-基线-条件三元组或具象行业微案例
